_meta.source: GET https://fapi.binance.com/fapi/v1/fundingInfo ("Query funding rate info for symbols that had FundingRateCap/FundingRateFloor / fundingIntervalHours adjustment"). The WIFUSDT row uses the documented fields with the 4h interval observed live on 2026-10-10: Binance !markPrice@arr gave WIFUSDT next funding 04:00Z at 01:04Z (off the 8h grid) and Bybit tickers gave WIFUSDT fundingIntervalHour 4. fapi.binance.com answers HTTP 451 from the capture machine
